question.en: Which animal can survive being frozen and then thawed?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang boleh hidup selepas dibekukan dan dicairkan semula?

funFact.en: Tardigrades survive extreme cold and heat.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade hidup dalam sejuk dan panas luar biasa.

question.en: What is the only mammal capable of true flight?
question.ms: Mamalia manakah satu-satunya yang mampu terbang sebenar?

funFact.en: Bats are the only mammals that can sustain flight.
funFact.ms: Kelawar satu-satunya mamalia yang terbang berterusan.

question.en: Which plant traps insects for nutrition?
question.ms: Tumbuhan manakah yang menangkap serangga untuk nutrisi?

funFact.en: Venus Flytraps digest insects to supplement poor soil nutrients.
funFact.ms: Venus Flytrap cerna serangga untuk tambah nutrien tanah.

question.en: What organism is called the 'immortal' one?
question.ms: Organisma manakah yang disebut sebagai 'abadi'?

funFact.en: It can revert its cells to an earlier stage.
funFact.ms: Ia boleh kembali sel ke peringkat awal.

question.en: Which insect can survive decapitation for days?
question.ms: Serangga manakah boleh hidup tanpa kepala beberapa hari?

funFact.en: Cockroaches live weeks without a head.
funFact.ms: Lipeng hidup berminggu tanpa kepala.

question.en: Which animal has blue blood?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang mempunyai darah biru?

funFact.en: Their blood is copper‑based, blue in color.
funFact.ms: Darahnya berasaskan kuprum, berwarna biru.

question.en: Which bird can mimic human speech?
question.ms: Burung manakah boleh meniru pertuturan manusia?

funFact.en: Parrots use syrinx muscles to mimic sounds.
funFact.ms: Burung kakak tua guna otot syrinx untuk suara.

question.en: Which animal lays the largest eggs?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah bertelur paling besar?

funFact.en: Ostrich eggs weigh up to 1.5 kg.
funFact.ms: Telur unta berat hingga 1.5 kg.

question.en: Which animal can taste with its feet?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah boleh merasa rasa dengan kaki?

funFact.en: Butterflies taste nectar with sensors on feet.
funFact.ms: Kupu‑kupu rasa nektar dengan deria di kaki.

question.en: Which microorganism is used to make bread?
question.ms: Mikroorganisma manakah digunakan untuk buat roti?

funFact.en: Yeast ferments sugars to make CO₂.
funFact.ms: Yis menapai gula untuk hasilkan CO₂.

question.en: What is the smallest bone in the human body?
question.ms: Apakah tulang terkecil dalam tubuh manusia?

funFact.en: Stapes helps transmit sound in the ear.
funFact.ms: Stapes membantu hantar bunyi di telinga.

question.en: Which amphibian can survive complete dehydration?
question.ms: Amfibia manakah yang boleh hidup sepenuhnya tanpa air?

funFact.en: They can survive years in dried state and revive when water returns.
funFact.ms: Boleh hidup bertahun-tahun dalam keadaan kering dan kembali hidup apabila air muncul.

question.en: Which animal can regrow its lost body parts?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang boleh menumbuhkan semula bahagian badan yang hilang?

funFact.en: Starfish can regenerate arms if damaged or lost.
funFact.ms: Bintang laut boleh menumbuhkan semula lengan jika rosak atau hilang.

question.en: Which animal’s blood is green due to copper compounds?
question.ms: Darah haiwan manakah berwarna hijau kerana sebatian kuprum?

funFact.en: Some octopuses have greenish blood because of copper-based hemocyanin.
funFact.ms: Sesetengah gurita mempunyai darah kehijauan kerana hemocyanin berasaskan kuprum.

question.en: Which insect can survive underwater for weeks?
question.ms: Serangga manakah yang boleh hidup di bawah air selama beberapa minggu?

funFact.en: They trap air under their wings to breathe underwater for weeks.
funFact.ms: Menjerat udara di bawah sayap untuk bernafas di bawah air.

question.en: Which bird migrates the longest distance?
question.ms: Burung manakah yang berhijrah jarak paling jauh?

funFact.en: Arctic Terns travel about 70,000 km per year.
funFact.ms: Burung Tern Artik terbang kira-kira 70,000 km setahun.

question.en: Which animal has the fastest heartbeat?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang mempunyai degupan jantung paling cepat?

funFact.en: Hummingbirds can beat their heart up to 1,260 times per minute.
funFact.ms: Hummingbird boleh degup jantung sehingga 1,260 kali per minit.

question.en: Which animal has the longest tongue relative to its body?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang mempunyai lidah paling panjang berbanding badan?

funFact.en: Chameleons can extend their tongue longer than their body length to catch prey.
funFact.ms: Chameleon boleh hulurkan lidah lebih panjang dari badan untuk tangkap mangsa.

question.en: Which animal can survive in the vacuum of space?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang boleh hidup dalam vakum angkasa?

funFact.en: Tardigrades can survive extreme radiation, vacuum, and temperatures.
funFact.ms: Tardigrade boleh hidup dalam radiasi, vakum, dan suhu ekstrem.

question.en: Which animal is known for the most powerful bite force?
question.ms: Haiwan manakah yang terkenal dengan daya gigitan paling kuat?

funFact.en: Saltwater crocodiles can bite with over 3,500 pounds of force.
funFact.ms: Buaya air masin boleh menggigit lebih 3,500 paun tekanan.
